name: Frostings, white, fluffy, dry mix (USDA food medium)
description: Food-derived medium from USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy): measured amino acids, sugars, fatty acids, vitamins and minerals of Frostings, white, fluffy, dry mix, plus a mineral base. Measured nutrients with no curated BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered; non-metabolite aggregates (energy, protein, total fat/fibre) are excluded by design.

provenance.citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, FoodData Central (SR Legacy), fdc.nal.usda.gov (FDC ID 168803).
provenance.notes: USDA measured nutrients mapped to BiGG via a curated nutrient->exchange table; amounts (per 100 g) in usda_amount/usda_unit. Unmapped measured metabolites kept in uncovered (v2). Aggregates excluded.
provenance.license_name: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication
provenance.url_status_note: USDA FoodData Central returns HTTP 404 for food-details URLs while its single-page app renders the correct food page client-side (verified 2026-09-06: curl -> 404 with an identical app shell for every id; headless Chromium -> the correct title and nutrient table). The link works for a reader and fails for a link-checker. Do not retire it.

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

oxygen_note: food substrate; O2 availability is a simulation condition, not a property of the food

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
